title: Migration Quickstart Visuals: compact catalog card + pricing overlay for sunset notice
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and produce a set of compact, production-ready visual assets for the Model Catalog release notes that communicate a model sunset and recommended migration path. Deliverables include: 1) a compact catalog card showing deprecation badge + recommended replacement model chip; 2) a pricing overlay comparing per-token cost and expected monthly bill for small/medium/large workloads; 3) a migration CTA modal/tooltip asset that fits into the quickstart flow; 4) explicit keyboard-and-screen reader friendly text variants for release notes and Console. Aim for pixel-perfect exports for web release notes, product console hero, and a 2x retina PNG for docs. Avoid duplicating existing catalog hero imagery — this should be a compact, badge-forward asset that pairs with copy in the release note paragraph.
acceptance_criteria: Compact catalog card artboard exported as PNG and SVG (desktop and mobile widths) with deprecation badge visible
Pricing overlay includes three workload rows (small/medium/large) and shows per-token delta between deprecated and recommended model
Migration CTA asset shows primary action text "Migrate to recommended model" and secondary "Open migration guide"
All assets reviewed by PM and Eng and approved in Figma comments
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in release PR with file names matching release asset naming conventions
tasks: Create Figma artboards: Compact Catalog Card (desktop 480x260, mobile 360x180)
Design pricing overlay table and compute token cost delta mockups
Write microcopy for badge states: Deprecated, Sunset Date, Recommended
Export PNG/SVG/2x retina and create accessible text-only variants
Add assets to release Drive folder and attach to GitHub release PR
Follow up with QA to validate visuals in staging release notes page
decisions: Use orange 'Sunset' badge (Hex #FF7A00) with tooltip explaining end-of-support timeline
Recommendation chip will show model name + 2-line cost delta (e.g., -35% tokens) rather than absolute price to avoid cloud pricing variance
Primary CTA text will be 'Migrate to recommended model' to emphasize action over learning
We will provide a condensed text-only screenshot for accessibility and email release notes
review_feedback: Priya (PM): Please include an explicit note about behavior when pinned model versions exist — showed in top-right microcopy
Evan (Eng): Suggested reducing iconography to avoid clutter at mobile width; recommended testing on 320px width

Design critique (2026-03-12): tighten spacing on pricing table and increase contrast on badge text to meet AA
